margin_basis: External scenario: inherited 2000 times 1.5; NOT reconstructed historical broker margin. Gross across packages through both leg closures.
strategy: Unchanged T5_E4_P3 first signals; unchanged locked tokens, route, direction, months and quantity per package; original +60s execution observations.
state_set: Continuous [-policy,+policy]: endpoints, 25bp nodes, actual-token rule boundaries with exact points and left/right limiting payouts. NO is complement of YES. Ambiguous rules conservatively zero payout. Metadata is retrieved retrospectively; historical rule versions remain unverified.
risk: Terminal total package worst loss across fixed policy/residual scenarios; gross sum across concurrently unfinished packages. Fixed from entry until PM paid and both futures legs closed; absolute initial-equity budget, no win-based reuse before close. Not a bound on intraday NAV drawdown or all possible policy changes.
entry_VM: Worst futures-only terminal debit PLUS 41.67 times far-leg temporary shock bp; full future unelapsed far month fraction=1. This bounds a declared cumulative-entry cash-path stress floor, not measured maximum debit.
remaining_VM: While any futures leg open, max(0, n*entry_VM_per_package + booked_CME_pnl); zero after both close. Uses only already booked cash, not future PM payouts. Entry cumulative stress floor is never reset; if actually exceeded, log stress-envelope breach and admit no new entries while open.
sizing: Maximum nonnegative whole packages at each fixed signal under min(observedCMEdepth, remaining gross risk budget / unit risk, current cash minus existing margin and remaining VM reserve / unit cash+margin+VM). No fixed 25k idle floor or per-event dollar cap. No global/clairvoyant allocation objective.
cash_clocks: Inherit prior fixed protocol; next bank-day available marks, meeting+2 business-day PM payment, monthend+7day rolled-forward final release. Proxies not measured broker times.
fees: Inherit 5%*Q*p*(1-p) scenario +2c per digital +$5 per package; margin and VM reserves never deducted as loss.
limits: PM historical bid/ask depth unknown; all scaled fills conditional, verified executable median unknown. Previously inspected sample, no untouched out-of-sample claim. September2026 pending not zero.
snapshot_note: Inspection snapshot: source paths adapted for external private inputs. Frozen model parameters retained. Original input hashes retained as provenance; not a claim that private inputs are bundled.
